name: Boku no Tame ni Kane wa Naru
source:
Main hero is a salary-man who is tired of work. He feels depressed and even his lover can't make him relax. As a coincidence, he witnesses a love scene of his boss and office lady which invigorates him with excitement. He starts to push his acquaintance girls to hook with other men.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-december-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公是一名疲于工作的上班族。他终日情绪低落，就连恋人也无法令他放松。一次偶然间，他目睹上司与一名女职员做爱，竟因此感到兴奋并重新振作起来。从那以后，他开始逼迫自己认识的女性与其他男人发生关系。

[内容取自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-december-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
